mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer demand environment that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating industrial production index signals a strengthening supply-side recovery that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following an accelerating INDPRO

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a deteriorating labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a flattening yield curve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening construction sector that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rising unemployment rate.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating GDP growth rate signals a strengthening economic expansion that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth accelerates > 1pp from prior quarter
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered quarters

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in nonfarm payrolls signals a weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, especially if accompanied by a decline in retail sales.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index signals a rising inflation environment that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by a flattening yield curve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances
